title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single centered card on an otherwise empty page. At the top is the product mark "ANDS Studio" with a small dot icon, then the heading "Sign in" and one line of small grey text: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." Below are two labeled fields, "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password", then a primary button "Sign in →" next to a plain-text button "New client? Create a workspace". Under those sits a smaller link-style button, "Forgot password?". The primary button stays disabled until both fields have something in them, and reads "Working…" while it submits. Pressing Enter in the password field also submits.

Clicking "New client? Create a workspace" swaps the same card into signup mode: the heading becomes "Create your workspace", the subtext becomes "One workspace per client company — dossiers, documents and filings stay isolated.", and a "Company / client name" field appears above Email (placeholder "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). As you type a password, live helper text below the field shows the rule "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.", counts down remaining characters if you are short, and flips to "✓ Meets the password rules." when satisfied. The buttons become "Create workspace →" and "Have an account? Sign in". Errors from either mode appear as a red notice box inside the card.

Choosing "Forgot password?" changes the heading to "Reset your password" with the explanation that a one-time code expiring in 15 minutes will be issued. You enter your email and click "Send me a code →". Because this environment has no email delivery, the code is displayed directly on screen in a notice box, followed by a "One-time code" field (placeholder "8-digit code") and a "New password" field. "Set new password →" completes it and returns you to sign-in with the notice "Password updated — sign in with your new password." A "Back to sign in" button is always available.

After signing in or creating a workspace, you are routed to the dossier manager: a top bar with "ANDS Studio", chips for "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →", plus a user chip showing your email and workspace name with a "Sign out" button. The page heading is "Your product dossiers". Note the workspace name shown in the chip is stored in your browser, so it can be blank on another device even when you are signed in.
